subject: How do I update my website logo?
body: Hi, I just got a new logo designed. How do I replace the one on my site header? Thanks, Maria

subject: Changing my homepage colours
body: Where can I change the main colours of my website? I want to match my brand.

subject: Add a new membership level
body: How can I add a third membership plan priced differently from the first two?

subject: Export member list
body: Is it possible to download a CSV of all my members? I need it for a mailing.

subject: Set up welcome email
body: How do I edit the email new members receive after signing up?

subject: Creating a custom page
body: Where do I create an About Us page and add it to the menu?

subject: Connect my own domain
body: How to point my own domain name to the site you host for me?

subject: Hide a menu item
body: How do I hide the Blog link from the top menu without deleting the page?

subject: Add search filters
body: Is it possible to let visitors filter listings by city and category?

subject: Change the contact form email
body: Where do I change which address receives contact form messages?

subject: Mobile menu settings
body: How can I make the menu look better on phones? It's cramped.

subject: Upload photos in bulk
body: How do I upload many listing photos at once instead of one by one?

subject: Payment integration stopped working
body: Since yesterday my payment gateway is not working. Customers see an error at checkout.

subject: Emails not arriving
body: Our members say they don't receive the signup confirmation email. Nothing in spam either.

subject: Cannot log in to admin
body: I can't log in to the admin area, it says my password is invalid but I just reset it.

subject: Images not showing
body: The listing images are broken on every page since this morning. Error 404 on each one.

subject: Search returns nothing
body: Our site search fails for any keyword, it always shows zero results.

subject: Mobile layout broken
body: The homepage doesn't work on iPhone, buttons overlap and the menu won't open.

subject: SSL warning
body: Browsers show a security warning on our domain, the certificate seems wrong.

subject: Form submits blank
body: The contact form submission fails with an error and nobody gets the message.

subject: Slow admin
body: The admin dashboard is very slow and sometimes the save button fails with a timeout.

subject: Coupon code error
body: Coupon codes can't be applied, checkout says invalid even for new codes.

subject: Booking feature
body: Can you add a booking calendar so customers can reserve appointments on our site?

subject: Integrate our CRM
body: We need a new integration so every signup is pushed into our CRM automatically.

subject: Custom dashboard
body: Can you build a custom dashboard showing monthly signups and revenue for our team?

subject: Multi-language site
body: We would like a new feature: the site in English and Spanish with a language switch.

subject: Loyalty points
body: Can you create a loyalty points system for returning members?

subject: Custom report
body: Can you develop a custom report that lists expiring memberships each week?

subject: Please cancel my plan
body: Please cancel my subscription effective today and refund this month's payment.

subject: Charged twice
body: I was charged twice in March, I want a refund for the duplicate payment.

subject: Cancel before renewal
body: I want to cancel before my annual renewal next week. How do I stop the charge?

subject: Refund for unused months
body: We stopped using the platform in June. Can I get a refund for the remaining months?

subject: Cancel add-on
body: Cancel the SEO add-on from my plan please, and money back for this cycle.

subject: Chargeback warning
body: If you don't refund the renewal I will open a chargeback with my bank.

subject: Your update broke our site
body: Your latest update broke our site. Our customers could not order all day. This is unacceptable.

subject: Very disappointed
body: I am very disappointed with support. Three days waiting is terrible service.

subject: Lost listings
body: Half of our listings disappeared after your migration. We are furious and losing business.

subject: Rude chat agent
body: The chat agent was rude to me yesterday. This is the worst support I've had.

subject: Downtime again
body: Third outage this month. We are paying for a reliable service and this is unacceptable.

subject: Misleading promise
body: Sales told us the feature was included, now it costs extra. I feel misled and angry.

subject: Quote for redesign
body: Could you give us a quote for redesigning our homepage and listing pages?

subject: Price for extra feature
body: How much would it cost to add a customer review system to our site?

subject: Estimate migration
body: We need an estimate to migrate our old WordPress data into your platform.

subject: Pricing for training
body: What is the price for a two-hour training session for my staff?

subject: Cost of custom integration
body: Can you quote the cost of integrating our accounting software?

subject: Following up on my request
body: Following up on my email from Monday about the logo issue. Any update?

subject: Did you receive my files
body: Checking in: did you receive the files I sent last week for the new pages?

subject: Still waiting
body: I am still waiting for a reply about the invoice question I sent on the 3rd.

subject: Any update on ticket
body: Any update on ticket #4821? It has been five days.

subject: Follow up on proposal
body: Just following up on the proposal you sent. When can we expect the next step?
